title: Main Street, Headford, Headford, Co. Galway, H91XR4K

description:
An excellent opportunity to acquire a well-proportioned four-bedroom detached family home ideally positioned on Main Street in the popular town of Headford, Co. Galway. 
Extending to approximately 134 sq. m. (1,443 sq. ft.), this attractive two-storey residence offers generous and versatile accommodation, making it an ideal choice for families seeking space, convenience and easy access to Galway City.
The property is approached via a welcoming entrance hall, leading to a comfortable sitting room featuring an open fireplace and bespoke built-in units. A particularly appealing feature of the ground floor is the spacious family room, complete with a solid-fuel stove and sliding doors opening onto the paved patio, creating a natural space for family living and entertaining.
The kitchen is fitted with PVC cabinetry, Formica countertops and electrical appliances and benefits from a separate rear access door. A generous utility room provides additional storage and laundry facilities, together with the property's Firebird oil boiler.
Upstairs, the accommodation comprises four well-proportioned bedrooms, with several rooms benefiting from fitted wardrobes. The principal bedroom has the added benefit of an ensuite shower room, while the main bathroom and hotpress complete the first-floor accommodation. An attic access point is also provided from the landing.
Externally, the property benefits from a paved patio, two side entrance gates and a separate outbuilding extending to approximately 17 sq. m., providing excellent additional storage space.
Constructed in 1999 using block-and-plaster construction with an insulated cavity, the property benefits from PVC double-glazed windows and doors, oil-fired central heating, an open fireplace and solid-fuel stove.
Location
The property enjoys a highly convenient position on Main Street, Headford, placing the amenities and services of the town within easy reach. Headford offers a good range of shops, schools, services and recreational facilities, while Galway City is approximately 26 km away.
This is a well-located and spacious family home offering comfortable accommodation with excellent potential for its new owners.
Early viewing is highly recommended.
This property will appeal to a wide variety of purchasers and Vincent Walsh Auctioneers will strive to be ultra flexible around property viewings.
